name: snap-to-guides
description: A horseshoe magnet with solid pole tips beside two perpendicular guides.
useCase: Snap moved objects to the canvas alignment guides.
misuse: Use a label to distinguish grid snapping from guide snapping.

16.reason: Solid pole caps keep the smaller magnet readable beside separate guide edges.

24.reason: The larger magnet leaves wider clear space from both perpendicular guide edges.
